# Drinks & Spirits

> Daily AI-assisted intelligence on global beverage, beer and spirits markets: Pernod Ricard, Heineken, innovation, RTD, No-Low and M&A.

Content is in English. Articles are collected nightly from public RSS feeds of pet food trade publications; summaries and the daily briefing are AI-generated, and each item links to its original source.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beverage-watch/): articles of the last 30 days with the daily briefing
- [Archive](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beverage-watch/archive/index.html): one page per month, all articles

## Machine-readable

- [Atom feed](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beverage-watch/feed.xml): 50 latest articles
- [JSON data](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beverage-watch/data.json): briefing and articles from the last 30 days
- [Sitemap](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/beverage-watch/sitemap.xml)

## Categories

- 🤝 Strategy & M&A
- 📈 Market
- 🍸 Spirits & Premium
- 🍺 Beer & Brewing
- 💡 Innovation & No-Low

## Sources

- [Pernod Ricard & Heineken Watch (Google News)](https://news.google.com): Actualités mondiales, résultats financiers, stratégie de marque et nominations.
- [Just Drinks](https://www.just-drinks.com/): La référence internationale B2B sur l'industrie mondiale des boissons et bières.
- [The Spirits Business](https://www.thespiritsbusiness.com/): Tendances spiritueux, bars, cocktails, lancements premium et marché du luxe.
- [The Drinks Business](https://www.thedrinksbusiness.com/): Actualités du commerce international du vin, des spiritueux et de la bière.
- [Inside Beer](https://www.inside.beer/): Marché international de la bière, investissements brasseries, Heineken & rivaux.
- [Beverage Daily](https://www.beveragedaily.com/): Innovations produits, packaging, boissons sans alcool (No-Low) et durabilité.
